name: Investigate cross-branch event-log linearity during expedition closure
goal: Formalize the fast-forward-before-finish closure pattern proven live on d8a555db237507e5 and 20d934325ee30c1a: finishing on a canonical branch whose tip is a strict ancestor of main kept the derived event log linear across three branches and avoided replay divergence on later merges. Investigate (1) when lifecycle-event-bearing branches diverge from main and what replay and merge hazards follow, including interaction with existing repair tooling, (2) whether fast-forward reconciliation is always safe and how to detect mechanically when it is not, (3) what the CLI owes operators here: pre-finish ancestry verification, warnings, or automatic reconciliation. Deliverable: evidence-based findings plus zero or more follow-up expedition proposals for automation or documentation
